generation.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one opaque square fantasy MMORPG inventory item icon for World of ClaudeCraft, contract woc-item-icon-v1. Paint Vanguard's Feral Staff (vanguard_feral_staff), a two-handed physical combat staff for a feral druid. Thick dark hardwood haft, worn crimson leather grip, blackened steel reinforced ends with burnished gold trim, upper end sculpted as a compact bestial claw clutching a solid crimson enamel oval, no caster crystal or magic beam. Complete long staff diagonal bottom-left to top-right, centered with safe padding, 70 percent square fill. Premium hand-painted classic dark fantasy MMO inventory art, tactile wood grain, leather and metal, warm top-left key light, cool deep shadow, crisp focal edge, softer peripheral brushwork, charcoal-umber opaque painted vignette. Three provided images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: long weapon diagonal and safe padding, buckler material/light, pouch tactile treatment. Do not copy their subjects. No text, letters, numbers, pseudo-writing, border, rarity frame, watermark, transparency, cropped tip/base, hands or mannequin. Generate one square image, 1024x1024.
generation.processing: Sharp resize to 512x512 sRGB opaque PNG master; npm run assets:items emits the 128x128 WebP.
